records.title: 10-K
records.text: During 2021, sales to our distributors represented approximately 10% of our total net sales, compared to 2% in 2020.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •The current portion of deferred revenue increased by $6 million due to increased billings related to renewals of our software maintenance and subscription-licensing offerings.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: No single customer represented more than 3% of our sales in each of 2021, 2020 and 2019.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Despite these headwinds, we are confident in our ability to continue to accelerate growth and improve our operating profitability through sustainable increases in demand attributable to recent investments that enhance our system and software offerings, realization of strategic price increases, and robust expense management.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: For the year ended December 31, 2021, operating income was $118 million, a decrease of 41% compared to 2020.
